_comment: Published list prices for each lab's own models, US dollars per million tokens. This is the price a serving
scenario earns on frontier tokens under the 'list' price basis: the lab sells its own models at its own list price.
(The default 'effective' basis uses OpenRouter's traffic-weighted effective price for the same models instead.)
Anthropic rows: seeded from the Anthropic pricing page; update.py confirms each daily from OpenRouter's public
endpoint feed, where the 'Anthropic' provider row carries the same list price, and overwrites on a change.
OpenAI rows: seeded from the OpenAI developer pricing docs (standard tier, short context). OpenRouter's OpenAI
endpoints come in flex / standard / fast tiers; update.py compares the standard-tier row and LOGS a difference
rather than overwriting, because on 2026-09-04 that row ($2/$10 for Sol) disagreed with both OpenAI pages
($4/$20 developer docs, promotional through at least 2026-11-21; $5/$30 openai.com marketing page).
Batch API is 50% off list at both labs; 'realisation' in assumptions.json is where a discount to list is applied.
